families.title: Enabled action inventory
families.hypothesis: Read distinct enabled action labels at the declared start, retaining nondeterministic edges.

families.title: Reachable state closure
families.hypothesis: Return exactly the states reachable from the declared start, including the zero-step path.

families.title: Shortest bad-state counterexample
families.hypothesis: Find the shortest action-sorted path to a target; null means no target is reachable in this finite graph.

families.title: Reachable deadlock inventory
families.hypothesis: Report reachable states with no outgoing raw transition; never erase deadlocks through totalization.

families.title: Existential eventual target
families.hypothesis: Classify states from which some finite path reaches a target.

families.title: Universal eventual target
families.hypothesis: Classify states where every path eventually reaches a target, with deadlocks stuttering forever.

families.title: Existential persistent region
families.hypothesis: Classify states with some infinite path entirely inside the allowed region under explicit deadlock stuttering.

families.title: Existential until target
families.hypothesis: Classify states that can reach a target while all earlier states stay in the allowed region.

families.title: Recurrent component structure
families.hypothesis: Partition the complete graph into strongly connected components and mark raw cycles.

families.title: Nondeterministic action conflicts
families.hypothesis: List each state/action pair with more than one distinct successor.

families.title: Strong simulation relation
families.hypothesis: Retain pairs for which every left action can be matched by a right action recursively.

families.title: Strong bisimulation partition
families.hypothesis: Partition one labelled graph by greatest two-sided action matching.

families.title: Bounded trace inclusion counterexample
families.hypothesis: Find a shortest left trace absent on the right up to the declared depth; absence is bounded, not equivalence.

families.title: Bisimulation quotient readback
families.hypothesis: Project action edges between strong bisimulation classes without claiming causal or physical equivalence.

families.title: Synchronous product reachability
families.hypothesis: Explore pairs reached when both models take the same explicit action label.

families.title: Adversarial reachability region
families.hypothesis: Compute a finite reachability-game winning region with existential controller choice and universal environment choice.

families.title: Counterexample step narration
families.hypothesis: Pair a valid finite trace with ordered text and exact edge records while reserving human comprehensibility.

families.title: Observation loss projection
families.hypothesis: Keep visible trace events and count explicitly hidden events without equating projection with the original behavior.

families.title: Evaluation prerequisite missingness
families.hypothesis: List missing real evaluation modes from supplied evidence labels; this phase supplies none.

families.title: Release-role vacancy hold
families.hypothesis: Expose missing declared roles while keeping actual external authority and external action false.
